thread:
nova: Quick report from the quant4b bring-up: were seeing a narrow but consistent failure mode on multi-step instruction prompts (lists, how-tos). Int8 looks fine; int4/int4-fast-path shows invented list items.

sam: Any pattern in source or length?

nova: Short-to-mid length (20-80 tokens), often with numbered/ordered outputs. I exported 80 suspect cases to /mnt/curation/q4b_kernel_fails_80.json.

tess: Could be kernel ordering effect: some int4 kernels reorder matmul ops for perf and that might change numerical rounding in early layers. Ill try toggling kernel-order flag on a small run.

ali: Also check sampling config parity. We had a default temp shift when enabling the fast path last week.

nova: Confirmed: the fast-path run used temp=0.9 in the smoke harness, the baseline used 0.7. I'll re-run with matched decoding.

curation-bot: created task curation/7012 (owner: tess)  80 items queued. Dedupe rule: fuzzyhash 0.83, embed cosine 0.88.

tess: I'll take labeling. Label schema: label [hallucination, tokenization, numeric-drift, sampling, other], note field. ETA 5h for first 20.

sam: I'll run two benches: (1) kernel-order=orig + temp=0.7, (2) kernel-order=fast + temp=0.7. Command: python tools/quant_bench.py --model rdx-4b --quant int4 --prompts /mnt/curation/q4b_kernel_fails_80.json --decoding=sample --seed=42 --out runs/3645-kerneltest

ali: If labels show >50% hallucinations independent of sampling, infra should try per-layer float fallback for layers 0-2. Also snapshot attention scores.

nova: For golden sets, create golden/q4b_kernel_regress.json with 80 fails + 80 matched passes. Keep it separate from main golden.

curation-bot: golden suite created: golden/q4b_kernel_regress.json (size: 160). CI hook scheduled for quant PRs.

tess: Will post tag breakdown after first 40 labels. Thanks all.
